rule: Each bot MUST use only its own url_env+key_env. Generic WEBHOOK_URL/WEBHOOK_AUTH are MBP's legacy names — do not use from other bots. Prefer MBP_WAKE_URL/MBP_WAKE_KEY aliases once created.

Air Grok Bot.note: Mac HTTP bridge path; keep names for now or alias AIR_WAKE_* later

MBP Grok Bot.note: Legacy URL fallback is MBP-only. Set MBP_WAKE_KEY to the bare key in the dispatcher environment; WEBHOOK_AUTH is not a key alias.

forbidden_cross_use: No bot may pass another bot's url_env/key_env as wake.
Ada/TW/TF/Air must never set wake.url from WEBHOOK_URL.
